in_hebrew.name: Richardo
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Richardo הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin 'ricardus', meaning 'powerful ruler' or 'brave, strong, and powerful'. The name has been popular among Christians throughout history, particularly in Spain and Italy.
